text:
maria: FYI — spike of APAC SSE disconnects + partial-streams + duplicated billing events starting ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customers reported reconnect loops and duplicate tokens billed. I captured one customer's trace and a quick repro below. Escalating to eng + billing.

sam: oncall here, looking. Is this isolated to a specific pool/region? any recent deploys? :eyes:

maria: appears concentrated in apac-1 (sg region) GPU pools. We had a runtime deploy last night (2.4.3) that touched flow-control/batching. No config changes on routing.

lee: grabbing logs from the apac-1 runtime nodes now. Initial telemetry shows a lot of partial SSE frames where the last chunk is never flushed and client reconnects replay, which causes duplicate invoiceable token events.

kai: copying what I'm seeing: many streams show terminal connection resets with a 502-level websocket proxy (envoy) entry, but the runtime process logs show successful write to socket. Suspect mismatch between chunk framing and proxy flush.

maria: example client repro (customer supplied). Repro steps we asked them to run:

```
# repro - reproduces drop in ~30s
curl -N \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Region: apac-1" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/streams?model=text-compact-001&stream=true" \
| sed -n '1,200p'
```

maria: sample broken output captured (note the trailing incomplete chunk and then immediate reconnect):

```
event: data
data: {"token":"hello","logprobs":-0.23}

event: data
data: {"token":" world","logprobs":-0.18}

# then socket close mid-chunk
event: data
data: {"token":"! Th"
# client reconnects and server replays from last ack -> duplicate tokens billed
```

alex: customer-impact: 3 mid-market customers reported 2-5 duplicate invoiceable events each. They are asking for immediate mitigation and a billing credit.

nina: billing here — we can dedupe at pipeline if we get a reliable request-id correlation. Do we have an id that survives reconnects?

lee: runtime includes a per-request request-id header and persistent stream-id, but on abrupt socket close some clients reconnect with a new stream-id causing billing to treat as new. We can change billing to dedupe by original request-id header if provided by clients.

sam: mitigation plan (short): 1) route APAC traffic off newly-upgraded pools -> failover to apac-legacy (2.4.2) 2) advise customers to temporarily disable streaming (set stream=false) or use polling 3) enable billing dedupe by x-request-id for today 4) rollback runtime 2.4.3 on apac-1 if rollback quick.

ops-bot: deploy.event: rollback job started for apac-1 -> target runtime: 2.4.2. Job id: deploy-8732.

lee: started rollback to 2.4.2 on 6 nodes. Also pushing a hotfix that forces a final chunk/flush on close path. Will test on one node first.

kai: routing change live: emergency route policy sent customers with tag "apac-fallback" to apac-legacy cluster. Confirmed reduced 502 proxy errors on metrics.

maria: customer message drafted: "We've detected intermittent stream termination in APAC caused by a runtime flow-control regression. We've routed your traffic to a fallback cluster and are rolling back the recent runtime. We're also proactively deduplicating billing events for impacted requests. Apologies for the disruption."

alex: customers want repro steps we asked them to try to confirm. Add: tell them to run the curl above and if they see partial chunks, send the raw stdout.

nina: billing task created: BILL-2241 to apply credits and run dedupe job. I'll need a list of affected request-ids or at least customer ids and approximate windows (09:12-09:48 UTC).

lee: telemetry note: stacktrace around flush path looks like this in runtime logs:

```
2026-11-12T09:12:15Z runtime[pid=7728]: WARN flush: write partial chunk, err=EPIPE
2026-11-12T09:12:15Z runtime[pid=7728]: INFO stream_id=rx-9a1f: initiating reconnect cleanup
2026-11-12T09:12:15Z runtime[pid=7728]: DEBUG flush: attempted flush size=2048 frame=0x7ff...
```

lee: hypothesis: small window where proxy (envoy) expects CRLF chunk boundaries and runtime flush returns before proxy has enqueued final bytes -> socket close -> client reconnects and replay occurs. Hotfix will add explicit flush+delimiters and a final EOF event before closing.

sam: timeline & status:
- 09:12 UTC: first reports (maria)
- 09:20 UTC: engineering triage starts
- 09:28 UTC: route policy applied (apac -> apac-legacy)
- 09:35 UTC: rollback job started
- 09:40 UTC: billing dedupe enabled
- 09:48 UTC: metrics show reconnects down ~85%

maria: customer comms sent to affected accounts. Support double-checking repros and collecting request-ids.

alex: ask product/legal about broad credit policy? Some customers requested pro-rata credits for duplicate bill.

nina: we'll calculate credits per duplicated token after dedupe job; will propose credits equivalent to invoiceable tokens duplicated in window.

lee: hotfix deployed to a single canary node and re-run repro; no more mid-chunk closes on that node. Preparing full rollback/patch depending on rollback speed.

maria: support action items for agents: 1) ask customers to run the curl and paste raw output + request-id header 2) advise to set stream=false for immediate avoid 3) note we should add X-Request-ID to customer SDKs docs 4) collect impacted customers for billing.

sam: severity currently SEV2. I'll keep this thread updated. If anything changes to SEV1 we escalate.

ops-bot: deploy.event: rollback job completed on apac-1 -> 6 nodes -> SUCCESS. job: deploy-8732.

lee: post-rollback metrics show reconnect rate back to baseline, streaming error rate dropped to normal. Will keep monitoring for 24h. Patch PR open (runtime#4021) to ensure final chunk flush and optional server-side replay-safety token.

maria: closing loop: created triage doc with repro, logs, and analysis: https://internal.redwood/docs/incidents/1930456789 (internal). We'll follow up with root-cause writeup after 24h monitoring. :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks everyone — excellent cross-team response. Nina, please post billing credit plan when ready.

nina: will post BILL-2241 details in this thread once credits calculated.

alex: customer success will check back with affected accounts tomorrow morning APAC local.

maria: marking thread as resolved->monitoring; reopen if any regression. :v:
